data.one_liner: Windows implementation of image_picker for selecting images and videos
data.what_it_does: Provides a Windows-specific implementation of the image_picker API. It allows picking images and videos from the file system and supports multi‑video selection.
use_when: Need to pick images or videos on a Windows desktop app
Want a drop‑in replacement for image_picker on Windows
Require support for multi‑video selection via getMultiVideoWithOptions
avoid_when: Need camera support without a custom cameraDelegate
Require image quality, maxWidth, maxHeight or maxDuration options
strengths: Endorsed federated plugin, auto‑included via file_selector
weaknesses: Camera not supported unless a cameraDelegate is provided
Limited option support (no maxWidth, maxHeight, imageQuality, maxDuration)
data.setup_notes: No additional permissions or build_runner needed; just import the package if using its APIs directly.

alternatives.name: image_picker
alternatives.why_pick_it: Cross‑platform image picker that includes Windows support via this plugin
